# WFT — Websites for Tradies

> WFT builds done-for-you websites for New Zealand tradies that generate real job enquiries. One flat price of NZ$1,997, live in 7 working days, backed by a Jobs In 90 guarantee.

## About

WFT (Websites for Tradies) is a New Zealand web design service specialising exclusively in tradie websites. The business writes the copy, designs the site, registers a .nz domain, sets up NZ hosting, and connects Google Business Profile — all included in the one-time price. If the site doesn't produce at least one genuine job enquiry within 90 days of going live, WFT rebuilds it for free.

## Service

- [Tradie Website Package](https://www.websitesfortradies.co.nz/): A complete 5+ page tradie website. Includes copywriting, mobile-first design, local SEO, .nz domain, 12 months NZ hosting, SSL, Google Business Profile setup, and the Jobs In 90 guarantee. One-time cost: NZ$1,997.
